sentences.japanese: 僕はボードの上の駒を一つ前に進めた。
sentences.english: I moved a chess piece on the board one forward.

sentences.japanese: 瓢箪から駒って言うのかな、知人の紹介で就職決まっちゃったんだよ。
sentences.english: I just got a great job because of an introduction from a friend. Sometimes things happen when you least expect it.

sentences.japanese: 日本の将棋には何種類の駒がありますか。
sentences.english: How many different pieces are there in Japanese chess?

sentences.japanese: チェスしてるよ。私、もう彼の駒を4つ取ったよ。
sentences.english: We're playing chess. I already took four of his pieces.

sentences.japanese: チェスをしてるんだ。僕、もう相手の駒4つも取ったんだ。
sentences.english: We're playing chess. I already took four of his pieces.
